description: Use for a supplied image reconstructed as intentionally awkward, primitive low-budget 3D while preserving subject count, broad layout, action, camera, scene type, major props, and dominant colors. Unlike preview-paint (relationship 0.61), choose this for deliberate geometry, rigging, texture, lighting, and rendering failure; choose preview-paint for a painted treatment. Unlike restyle-video (0.55), choose this for a source-image reconstruction with optional short continuation. Do not use for flattering low-poly art, VHS, pixelation, horror, or injury.
